title: Evidence for a Noachian-aged ephemeral lake in Gusev crater, Mars
text:
Bibliographic record (Crossref metadata, not the paper's full text): Evidence for a Noachian-aged ephemeral lake in Gusev crater, Mars.

Authors: S. W. Ruff, P. B. Niles, F. Alfano, A. B. Clarke.

Published in Geology, volume 42, issue 4, pages 359-362 (2014), publisher Geological Society of America. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1130/g35508.1.

This record describes what the publication is about; the peer-reviewed full text is behind the DOI and was not ingested. Claims about the site's geology or history that cite this record should be read as 'this paper exists and studied the named site', not as a quotation of its findings unless an abstract appears below.
